sourceVersion: Official P-CCS 2025-2026 School Year Calendar; updated June 10, 2025
seoDescription: P-CCS starts Sept. 2, 2025, and ends June 10, 2026. See kindergarten opening half days, K-5 conferences, P-CEP finals, breaks, times, and PDF.
heroSummary: P-CCS students start Tuesday, September 2, 2025, with a half day for all K-12 students. Kindergarten remains on half days September 3–4, while grades 1–12 move to full days. The last day is Wednesday, June 10, 2026, and both June 9 and June 10 are half days for all K-12 students.
calendarNotes: All K-12 students begin September 2 on a half day, and kindergarten alone continues with half days September 3-4. Five later K-5-only half days do not shorten middle-school or P-CEP attendance. January 14-16 are P-CEP finals half days, while grades 6-8 join the half-day schedule only January 15-16. April 14 affects grades 6-8 and April 16 affects grades 9-12, so those dates should not be imported as all-student early releases. June 8 is a grades 9-12 finals half day before all K-12 students move to half days June 9-10. Starkweather's bell times appear on the family PDF, but academy students need its separate quarterly calendar. The official P-CCS PDF is the canonical source; the user-provided MichiganSchools.us file was independently regenerated and is not treated as an official district publication.

customSections.label: How the Three-Day Kindergarten Opening Works
customSections.content: The first half day includes all K-12 students. Kindergarten stays on half days for two more dates while grades 1-12 begin full-day attendance.

customSections.label: P-CEP Finals and Grade-Band Half Days
customSections.content: P-CCS separates P-CEP finals from middle-school and all-student half days. The grade range printed for each date controls who leaves early.

customSections.label: Why This Page Does Not Use the Supplied 2025–26 PDF URL
customSections.content: The supplied URL and local two-page file were created by MichiganSchools.us in February 2026 and carry its author, copyright, QR code, and branding. A one-page official P-CCS PDF was recovered from the district's own Finalsite resources, so that official file is used for dates and downloads instead.

calendarFaqs.q: When did P-CCS start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: All K-12 students started Tuesday, September 2, 2025, on a half-day schedule. Kindergarten also attended half days September 3-4 while grades 1-12 had full days.

calendarFaqs.q: When was P-CCS Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Classes resumed Monday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When was P-CCS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 30, through Friday, April 3, 2026. Classes resumed April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: Which P-CCS dates were K-5-only half days in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The K-5-only half days were October 31, November 12-13, December 9, and March 11. The September 2 first day and June 9-10 half days applied to all K-12 students.

calendarFaqs.q: When were P-CEP finals half days in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 9-12 had finals half days January 14-16 and June 8. Grades 6-8 also had half days January 15-16, but the finals label applied to grades 9-12.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of P-CCS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Wednesday, June 10, 2026 was the last day, and it was a half day for all K-12 students. June 9 was also an all-student half day.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the MichiganSchools.us 2025–26 PDF an official P-CCS file?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It was independently generated and branded by MichiganSchools.us. This page uses the one-page official P-CCS PDF recovered from the district's Finalsite resources.
